stories.title: A decade of internal AI battles is finally catching up to Google
stories.simple_summary: Google has spent years fighting internally about how to build and use AI, and now those disagreements are causing real problems for the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and Google employees — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Secondhand booksellers in UK and Ireland suspect AI firms behind ‘strange’ bulk orders
stories.simple_summary: AI companies are secretly buying up lots of secondhand books in bulk, probably to train their AI systems by reading them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a used bookstore, watch for unusual large orders — someone may be trying to buy your inventory to feed AI without paying authors fairly.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
stories.simple_summary: Instagram changed its logo design and made it look very different from the old one.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect how you use Instagram — it's just a visual change to the app's appearance.

stories.title: AI’s Impact on the Environment Is Absolutely Horrifying, New Paper Finds
stories.simple_summary: A new study found that AI systems use huge amounts of energy and cause serious harm to the environment.
stories.why_it_matters: This is worth knowing about when considering what companies to support, though there's nothing specific you need to do right now.

stories.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
stories.simple_summary: Google is letting people remove the visible watermark (a small sparkle mark) from pictures and videos made by its AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's AI image or video tools, you can now hide the watermark that shows it was AI-made, though Google tracks it invisibly anyway.

stories.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
stories.simple_summary: Google will let you turn off the visible watermark on AI-made pictures and videos, but the file still has a hidden marker showing it came from AI.
stories.why_it_matters: Same as headline 4 — the watermark can be hidden but not truly removed, so AI-made content can still be tracked.

stories.title: The unexpected issue dividing parties and midterms candidates
stories.simple_summary: The headline is too vague to explain what issue is being discussed.
stories.why_it_matters: Without more details, it's impossible to say if this affects you.

stories.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
stories.simple_summary: Meta released a free AI tool anyone can download and use, while keeping a more powerful version only for itself.
stories.why_it_matters: If you want to experiment with AI tools yourself without paying, this free option exists — but the most powerful tools are still controlled by big companies.

stories.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
stories.simple_summary: A startup says that specialized computer chips (GPUs) might be better at handling AI work than experts thought.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon and Alphabet’s Profits Reveal Circular Nature of A.I. Boom
stories.simple_summary: Amazon and Google are making huge profits from the AI boom, showing how the money moves in a circle between AI companies and the cloud providers they depend on.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
stories.simple_summary: If natural gas prices go way up, it could cost big tech companies like Amazon and Google much more money to run their AI data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually lead to higher prices for cloud services, but any impact on your small business would be far down the road.

stories.title: Meta’s ‘open’ AI, and a $250M deal gone very wrong
stories.simple_summary: Meta released free AI software and said it should be available to everyone, but the company also did a failed business deal related to AI.
stories.why_it_matters: The free AI tool is available to try, but Meta's bigger and more powerful tools remain mostly under their control.
